title: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves
japaneseTitle: アンチャーテッド 黄金刀と消えた船団
shortDescription: Naughty Dog's cinematic tour de force that perfected the seamless Hollywood blockbuster video game.
historicalSignificance: The pinnacle of cinematic interactive pacing, seamlessly erasing the seam between gameplay and Hollywood cinema with moving physics set pieces (the runaway train, collapsing hotel) and setting a new benchmark for performance capture and character chemistry.

editorialContent.overview: Directed by Bruce Straley and written by Amy Hennig and Neil Druckmann at Naughty Dog, Uncharted 2: Among Thieves launched on the PlayStation 3 in October 2009. Following roguish treasure hunter Nathan Drake, Chloe Frazer, and Elena Fisher on a perilous hunt for Marco Polo's lost fleet and the Cintamani Stone in the mythical Himalayan kingdom of Shambhala, it delivered an unrelenting rollercoaster of cinematic action.
editorialContent.gameplay: Refined third-person cover shooting with dynamic traversal: Drake can vault over obstacles, hang from crumbling ledges while firing single-handed sidearms, and perform stealth neck-snaps. The set pieces are dynamic, moving environments—most famously an entire chapter fought aboard a speeding passenger train winding through icy Nepalese mountain passes.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Naughty Dog harnessed the PlayStation 3's notoriously complex Cell Broadband Engine SPUs to handle ambient occlusion, high-resolution depth of field, realistic snow deformation shaders, and fluid full-body motion capture.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Uncharted 2 won over 200 Game of the Year awards and earned a 96 Metacritic rating, solidifying Naughty Dog as Sony's premier studio and establishing the cinematic template that would culminate in The Last of Us.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on original PS3 Blu-ray media and remastered in 1080p 60fps by Bluepoint Games in Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection on PS4.

awards: Game of the Year 2009 (Spike VGAs, AIAS, GDC Awards, BAFTA)

technicalSpecs.engine: Naughty Dog Engine 2.0 (Cell Broadband Engine optimized)
technicalSpecs.soundChip: 7.1 Linear PCM uncompressed surround with Greg Edmonson orchestral score
